# After Hours Agenda

> Independent New York streetwear. Expressive everyday clothing — graphic tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, and accessories — designed after hours and printed to order, one at a time. Free US shipping ($20 flat rate to Canada, the UK, and Australia), secure Square checkout, 30-day returns.

After Hours Agenda is a NYC direct-to-consumer clothing brand. Every piece is made to order (printed on demand) to avoid overproduction and dead stock. Cuts are unisex. The customer-facing name is always "After Hours Agenda". Support: info@afterhoursagenda.com.

Individual products live at https://afterhoursagenda.com/product/<slug>. This file lists sections only — https://afterhoursagenda.com/sitemap.xml is the authoritative, always-current list of every live URL, product pages included.

## Shop
- [Home](https://afterhoursagenda.com/): Featured pieces and the current entry points into the catalog.
- [Shop all](https://afterhoursagenda.com/shop): The full catalog of tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, and accessories.
- [New arrivals](https://afterhoursagenda.com/new-arrivals): The most recently added pieces.
- [Men](https://afterhoursagenda.com/men): The catalog with men's sizing guidance. Cuts are unisex.
- [Women](https://afterhoursagenda.com/women): The catalog with women's sizing guidance. Cuts are unisex.
- [Unisex](https://afterhoursagenda.com/unisex): The catalog without a gender split.
- [Accessories](https://afterhoursagenda.com/accessories): Hats, beanies, bags, stickers, and pins.

## Help
- [FAQ](https://afterhoursagenda.com/faq): Orders, shipping, returns, fit, and care.
- [Shipping](https://afterhoursagenda.com/shipping): Free in the US; $20 flat rate to Canada, the UK, and Australia. Made to order in 2 to 5 business days, then usually 5 to 10 business days in transit.
- [Returns](https://afterhoursagenda.com/returns): Unworn items can be returned within 30 days and we cover return shipping; made-to-order production fees may be non-refundable once printing starts.
- [Size guide](https://afterhoursagenda.com/size-guide): Fit and measurements.
- [Care](https://afterhoursagenda.com/care): How to wash and keep a printed garment.
- [Track order](https://afterhoursagenda.com/track-order): Track with order number and checkout email.
- [Contact](https://afterhoursagenda.com/contact): Reach support.
